description: Frozen, shrink-only exemptions for native Roll POST handlers that predate the write-path test rule. Handlers with an existing DB-backed Rust HTTP integration test are recognised by the guard and must NOT be listed here. Add a test that calls the handler or its persist_<handler> writer before changing an entry.

modules.dismiss_pending: Legacy pending bridge handler. Add an endpoint-level DB test before its next behavioral change.
modules.issue_mutation: reorder_issues has no DB-backed HTTP test; the other handlers in this module are covered by tests/reading_cycle_containment.rs and recognised by the guard.
modules.reading_list: check_thread_memberships has no DB-backed HTTP test; the other handlers in this module are covered by DB-backed HTTP tests and recognised by the guard.

handlers.continuity_plans::adopt_reading_order: No DB-backed HTTP test exercises POST /api/v2/continuity-plans/from-reading-order; the continuity_plans module tests cover plan CRUD and locking. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
handlers.continuity_plans::confirm_plan_projectio: No DB-backed HTTP test exercises POST /api/v2/continuity-plans/{plan_id}/reading-orders/project. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
handlers.continuity_plans::create_release_source: No DB-backed HTTP test exercises POST /api/v2/continuity-plans/release-sources/. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
handlers.continuity_plans::delete_release_source: No DB-backed HTTP test exercises DELETE /api/v2/continuity-plans/release-sources/{source_id}. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
handlers.continuity_plans::update_release_source: No DB-backed HTTP test exercises PATCH /api/v2/continuity-plans/release-sources/{source_id}. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
handlers.custom_cbl::delete_overlap_decision: tests/custom_cbl.rs exercises overlap-decision GET/PUT but not DELETE /api/v2/reading-lists/{list_id}/overlap-decisions/{decision_id}. Add that route's DB-backed test before changing this handler.
handlers.queue_exclusions::check_excluded_status: No DB-backed HTTP test exercises POST /api/v2/queue-exclusions/status:check; the bulk exclude/restore routes are covered in tests/queue_exclusions_http.rs. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
handlers.reading_plan_sync::sync_released_issues_: Module tests exercise the sync logic against a disposable database but not POST /api/v2/reading-plan-sync/runs through the router. Add an endpoint-level DB test before changing this handler.
